That commit converted nearby DeviceAssociation bindings but missed DeviceAssociation.statusReason, which had been added by commit 925b08c4bf11c8da9804ff50af017766db10980e.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini. R5 historical profiles-resources.xml has no old build/StructureDefinition/definition references and uses tools/StructureDefinition/binding-definition entries, confirming the intended replacement pattern. FHIR-32779 repeated the same R5 complaint and was resolved no-change as no longer an issue; it was used as context only. A Zulip R4B process thread said FHIR-32106-style fixes should be fixed in both R4B and master.
reconciliation: Changed source/deviceassociation/structuredefinition-DeviceAssociation.xml so DeviceAssociation.statusReason uses http://hl7.org/fhir/tools/StructureDefinition/binding-definition instead of http://hl7.org/fhir/build/StructureDefinition/definition. After the edit, no active core source matches for the obsolete URL remained.
